title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Inside a Neural Network

questions.text: What part of a neural network assigns importance to each input signal?
questions.explanation: Weights are dials that determine how important a specific piece of information is to the network’s decision.

questions.text: The hidden layers process data without directly interacting with the outside world.
questions.explanation: Hidden layers act like internal teams that examine data but do not take raw inputs directly from the environment.
